name: shipcast
description: Operate Shipcast products and connected X accounts from local agents using browser-based authorization.

interface.shortDescription: Post to X and manage Shipcast X accounts
interface.longDescription: Use Shipcast from local agents to inspect connected X accounts, start X account connection flows, post directly to X through a product account, preview AI product updates, publish Shipcast updates, review publication history, and render Shipcast results as in-conversation widgets. Authorization is handled through Shipcast's browser or headless device flow; users do not paste API keys into MCP config.
defaultPrompt: Show my Shipcast X accounts as cards
Post this update to X through my Shipcast product
Preview and publish today's Shipcast product update
